sources.label: Rootstock public RPC (Mynt holder balanceOf snapshot)

reserveReview.rationale: Refresh 2026-08-20: Sovryn documents DLLR as a 1:1 Mynt basket whose supported bAssets are ZUSD and DOC, both BTC-backed. Rootstock public RPC at block 9,167,786 (2026-08-20T13:18:00Z) read balanceOf(Mynt MassetManager 0x5f777270259e32f79589fe82269db6209f7b7582) as 1,809,205.3931645737 ZUSD and 428.1826685298049 DOC, yielding 99.976338709% ZUSD and 0.023661291% DOC. ZUSD remains an untracked exogenous bAsset; the measured DOC holding is tracked and is emitted by the live envelope as its own linked branch.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Sovryn Mynt supported-bAsset documentation and Rootstock balanceOf snapshot at block 9,167,786
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Sovryn's Mynt documentation identifies ZUSD and DOC as the supported DLLR bAssets, and the Rootstock snapshot directly reads both balances in the configured MassetManager holder; this is an on-chain composition verification rather than an issuer attestation.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Sovryn identifies ZUSD as a supported DLLR bAsset, but it is not a tracked Pharos stablecoin and therefore cannot form a dependency graph edge.
